source: E. Martinez, O. Senninger, C.-C. Fu, F. Soisson, Phys. Rev. B 86, 224109 (2012), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevB.86.224109. Local PDF papers/PhysRevB.86.224109.pdf. Omega(x) from M. Levesque et al., arXiv:1307.7561v1 (29 Jul 2013; no journal reference printed in the PDF).
extraction: Table I read from a 150-dpi render of p.4 (pdftotext garbles it); Table II from p.6. Second independent transcription (Sonnet pass, scratchpad check/second_extraction.json) matched every value; see fecr-dft-sources.md section 0.
units: energies eV, entropies k_B, temperatures K, frequencies s^-1

shell_ratio.loc: Table I caption (the text on p.2 garbles it as '12', i.e. 1/2)

table_I.h1_AA_formula_as_printed: h(1)_AA = -2 H(A)/11, H(A) = H0(A) + int cP(A) dT
table_I.s1_AA_formula_as_printed: s(1)_AA = -2 S(A)/11, S(A) = int cP(A)/T dT
table_I.cP_Fe: 3 kB (310/T)^2 (310/T)/[exp(310/T)-1]^2 ... as printed: 3kB(310/T)^2 exp-form + 6.64e-4 kB T (Ref. 40). Printed numerator reads '310/T' inside the fraction; standard Einstein form is (theta/T)^2 e^(theta/T)/(e^(theta/T)-1)^2.
table_I.dHf_V_Fe_ref: DFT, Refs. 15, 41 (unit not printed in cell; eV per text p.5)

saddle_formulas.index_convention: first index = jumping atom, second = saddle neighbour; only 1NN of the saddle (6 sites)
saddle_formulas.entropy_rows: 6 st1_ij: same forms with dS_mig and s; dS0_mig(Fe)=dS2_mig(Fe)=dS0_mig(Cr)=dS2_mig(Cr)=2.1 kB (Refs. 42, 47)

table_I.dH_ref: DFT (SIESTA), this study; Cr values NM

attempt_frequency.loc: p.6, Sec. II C 4b ('Debye frequency nu_Fe ~ nu_Cr ~ 1e13 s^-1')

levesque_omega.loc: Levesque arXiv:1307.7561v1, Table I p.6, Eq. (9)

local_concentration.loc: Levesque p.6 (Sec. III B, unnumbered eq.); Martinez p.5 ('measured within the same range')
local_concentration.definition: c(Fe_i Cr_j) = [sum_{n=0..r} sum_k p_ik + sum_{n=0..r} sum_k p_jk] / (2 sum_{n=0..r} z(n)), z(0)=1, r=2 -> denominator 30; p=1 if site holds Cr; sites i and j themselves included

targets.note: Paper-reported values used only for comparison by replicate.py.

binding_text.CrV_in_Fe_PIM_or_DFT: Eb = dH3' - dH4' = 0.04 eV (weak Cr-V attraction)
binding_text.FeV_in_Cr_DFT: Eb = dH3' - dH4' = 0.19 eV; 'underestimated by the pair interaction model'
